title: Add ReminderAlarmReceiver
description: BroadcastReceiver fired by the exact alarm ExactAlarmScheduler schedules; reads the dose_log_id/title/text extras and posts the notification via NotificationHelper. No pester/escalation re-arming since this MVP's reminder is single-shot, not repeating.
acceptance_criteria: onReceive reads doseLogId via intent.getIntExtra(ExactAlarmScheduler.EXTRA_DOSE_LOG_ID, -1) and returns early if it's -1
onReceive reads title/text via intent.getStringExtra with ExactAlarmScheduler.EXTRA_TITLE / EXTRA_TEXT and returns early if either is null
onReceive calls NotificationHelper.sendReminder(context, doseLogId, title, text)
